answer: By the walnut of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The pearl lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the shale is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
